integrity: Infinite-family results are proved by Boolean walk bounds and numerical semigroup arithmetic; Bernoulli limit is proved by run-length estimates. Finite verification is corroborative, not substituted for proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to a directed n-cycle with one prescribed shortcut, synchronous disjunctive update, and uniform binary initialization. Worst-case quadratic exponent is classical. Uniform additive error is under two complete tours; an exact first-entry census is not given. Accessible comparisons do not rule out all historical equivalences; the full Neufeld-Shen 1998 article was unavailable.
title: A logarithmic typical convergence clock in the quadratic-exponent Wielandt OR network
